title: queltia × gouanii
intro: Queltia × gouanii, commonly known as the Queltia gouanii or Gouan's Queltia, is a hybrid plant species within the family Acanthaceae. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Queltia × gouanii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, contributing to its potential as a natural remedy for wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of Queltia × gouanii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
